specs.Item Type Name: 45W Type C Super Fast Charger Adapter with Cable

features: 45W Super Fast Charging Support :- 45W GaN Super Fast Charger delivers powerful and efficient charging with advanced Power Delivery (PD) fast charging technology, ensuring rapid charging performance for compatible Samsung Galaxy smartphones,Tablet and other USB-C devices.

Wide Compatibility with Samsung Galaxy Devices :- Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S26, S25, S24, S23, S22, S21,A55,A56,A35,M56,M35,,M16,Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8, Z Fold 7, Z Flip 7, Z Fold 6, Z Flip 6, FE, Plus, Ultra, Edge, Flip, Fold All Model, A Series, M Series, F Series and more USB-C smartphones, making it a versatile fast charger for everyday use.

USB-C Fast Charging Cable Included :- Comes with a durable Type-C to Type-C fast charging cable designed for high-speed charging and stable power delivery for Samsung Galaxy devices and other USB-C supported gadgets.

Multi-Layer Safety Protection :- Equipped with intelligent protection against over-voltage, overheating, short circuit and over-current, ensuring safe and reliable charging while protecting your device battery.
Compact & Travel Friendly Design :- Lightweight and portable USB-C wall charger adapter that easily fits into your pocket or bag, making it ideal for home, office, and travel use.
